$comment: Slice 12 section 4: the name of Anki's stock note type "Basic (and reversed card)" in each Anki interface language, for the #notetype header of the Anki export. Only names verified in a running Anki are listed (the spec's rule); for any other language the export leaves #notetype out and Anki asks which note type to use. English is from Anki's manual (docs.ankiweb.net, Importing: text files). To add a language, check the name in Anki set to that language and add it here.
